voiceover: People love to say your five dollar coffee is why you're broke. Let's check. Five dollars a day is about one hundred fifty a month. Invested for ten years at seven percent, that's roughly twenty-six thousand. Real money. But over thirty years it's about one hundred eighty-three thousand. So the coffee isn't the villain. Time is the lever. Small amounts only get big when you give them decades. Cut what you don't care about, not what you love. Comment CASH and I'll send you the calculator to price your own habits.
